summary_en: This Phase 2, open-label, single-arm study tests cemsidomide plus dexamethasone in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. Cemsidomide is taken by mouth once a day for 14 days, then stopped for 14 days, in each 28-day cycle; dexamethasone is taken by mouth once a week on Days 1, 8, 15 and 22 of each cycle, and treatment continues until a discontinuation criterion is met. The study aims to assess antimyeloma activity, and also safety, tolerability, PK and PD; the primary outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2, abierto y de un solo grupo, evalúa cemsidomida combinada con dexametasona en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario. La cemsidomida se toma por vía oral una vez al día durante 14 días, seguida de 14 días sin tratamiento, en cada ciclo de 28 días; la dexametasona se toma por vía oral una vez por semana los días 1, 8, 15 y 22 de cada ciclo, y el tratamiento continúa hasta que se cumpla un criterio de suspensión. El estudio busca evaluar la actividad antimieloma, y también la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética y la farmacodinamia; la medida de resultado principal no está indicada.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with multiple myeloma that has relapsed or is refractory.
Measurable disease at the time of enrollment.
At least 3 prior myeloma regimens, including an immunomodulatory drug, proteasome inhibitor, anti-CD38 antibody, and T-cell engager or CAR-T.
Side effects from prior cancer treatment resolved to baseline or grade 1 or lower.
not_for: Myeloma in the central nervous system.
Systemic light chain amyloidosis, POEMS syndrome, or myelodysplastic syndrome.
Significant cardiac disease or impaired heart function.
Blood clot event within 3 months before enrollment.
